title: Game night full of food idioms, organizer force-locks Thu
notes: Food-precision negative fixture: seven messages contain food words but no intent to eat together (idioms 'eating me alive', 'food for thought', 'eat my words', 'what's eating', 'food coma'; 'ate so much at lunch'; and the hard negative 'brb grabbing food from the dhall', which scores >= 2 lexicon points while a plan is active, so the local classifier has to reject it). The hungry flow must never start. Options from the explicit trigger: 1 Wed Oct 21 7pm, 2 Thu Oct 22 7pm, 3 Fri Oct 23 7pm (game night = 7pm), deadline Tue Oct 20 ~7:33pm. Also covers numbers ('1 3'), 'anything but wed', and '?' after a reference (maybe). Priya, the organizer, never votes, so 'everyone answered' can't fire. She force-locks Thu with 'homi lock thu' although Fri has more yes votes. The place is then set as text ('homi place: my apt'), not via the hungry flow.

'homi place: my apt' moves the plan to confirmed with that text place and no places lookup is made.
No unprompted message fires during the 12h fast-forward (confirmed has no nudges; the deadline and nudge jobs were cancelled at lock).
'/status' returns a one-message plan card: Thu Oct 22 7pm, the text place 'my apt', who's in and who's pending.
